summary: Short, steep kerb among apartments; homes 11-15 m away, cars park nearby.

best_section.where: Tree-shaded east kerb of Clarence Road, north of the side-street junction

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 11-18 m away on both sides: apartments, a detached house and more apartments across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars on both sides; the east kerb is only 33 m long and ends at a junction.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the street; signs are 2P Mon-Fri 7am-5pm and No Stopping near the junction.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign at one end
sun_shade: Street trees shade much of the kerb, mainly from the east and north.
